description: Implementation of MerchantConfigurationDao interface providing database access methods for MerchantConfiguration entities, utilizing QueryDSL for constructing JPA queries.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: A DAO implementation class for accessing MerchantConfiguration entities from the database.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a single MerchantConfiguration based on the key and MerchantStore.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves all MerchantConfiguration entries associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves MerchantConfiguration entries filtered by type and MerchantStore.
